5850.title: Preserve the selected checkout comparison base
5850.rootCauseOneLine: The checkout provider omits the selected new-branch merge base, so core falls back to the default branch.

prReviews.topFinding: Related metadata fix changes the host contract; no linked PR code was run.

5850.proposedFix: Populate the existing provider-result mergeBaseBranch from the typed new-branch request after a successful attach; leave the host protocol unchanged.
5850.caveats: Direct real-plugin/real-Git reproduction, repeated by the same agent in a second clean checkout; no live UI/CLI/API persistence run. Fix scoped to initial creation.
